name: Op-amp differentiator
summary: Uses an amplifier input/feedback arrangement to obtain a differentiating response over its intended operating band.
description: Uses an amplifier input/feedback arrangement to obtain a differentiating response over its intended operating band.

On a schematic, identify the input capacitance, feedback path and bandwidth-limiting network and trace the differentiated output and reference. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
A practical differentiator has an intended frequency range; the ideal mathematical label does not specify a stable component circuit.
